title: Video-Conditioned Generative Joint 2D-3D Hand Motion Recovery
abstract: Recovering faithful 3D hand motion from video remains challenging due to frequent occlusions and incomplete visual observations, which make frame-wise pose estimates unreliable and temporally inconsistent. To address this problem, we propose JoHan, a unified generative framework that recovers hand motion directly from video sequences without relying on intermediate per-frame pose predictions. Trained from scratch, our model jointly generates aligned 2D and 3D local hand pose sequences by learning their temporal dynamics and cross-representation correspondence. The generated 2D trajectories exploit direct spatial and temporal cues from the 2D images to guide the following generative 3D motion reconstruction, while the learned motion prior promotes temporal consistency. Their learned 2D-3D correspondence further enables recovery of the hand's global position and orientation relative to the camera. Extensive experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate significantly improved accuracy and speed in local hand-pose and camera-space reconstruction. Notably, our method captures much better hand-motion dynamics, producing significantly smoother motion than previous methods while maintaining high per-frame pose accuracy.
tldr: 提出JoHan生成框架，从视频联合生成2D-3D手部运动，提升精度、速度与平滑性。
motivation: 视频中手部频繁遮挡和不完整观测导致逐帧姿态估计不可靠且时序不一致，因此难以恢复忠实的3D手部运动。
method: JoHan无需中间逐帧姿态预测，从头训练并联合生成对齐的2D与3D局部手部姿态序列，学习时序动态和跨表示对应；生成的2D轨迹利用图像时空线索引导3D运动重建，运动先验增强时序一致性，2D-3D对应进一步恢复相机坐标系下的全局位置与朝向。
result: 在挑战性基准上，局部手部姿态和相机空间重建的精度与速度显著提升；方法能更好捕捉手部运动动态，在保持高逐帧姿态精度的同时生成显著更平滑的运动。
conclusion: 该工作提供了从视频直接联合生成2D-3D手部运动的统一生成式方案，绕开不可靠的逐帧估计，提升了手部运动恢复的准确性与时序平滑性。

title: Gaussian Density Splatting Network
abstract: This paper proposes a novel crowd counting approach, the Gaussian Density Splatting Network (GDSNet). Unlike methods that rely on conventional, grid-based density maps and are sensitive to spatial resolution, GDSNet represents a crowd as a superposition of continuous 2D Gaussian primitives. Our approach is built upon two key contributions. First, we introduce a control-point-based fitting mechanism to structure the prediction of the Gaussian parameters. We design a method to allocate a set of control points that define local regions, from which features are pooled to regress each primitive's parameters. Second, we adapt a differentiable Gaussian Splatting framework to the counting task by parameterizing each primitive with geometric parameters and a scalar density mass. This formulation allows the network to be trained end-to-end via spatial matching of differentiably rendered density maps, naturally providing both local density supervision and global count optimization. Extensive evaluations on four standard benchmarks show GDSNet consistently outperforms the state of the art.
tldr: 提出GDSNet，用连续2D高斯图元叠加表示人群，并通过可微高斯泼溅与控制点拟合实现端到端计数。
motivation: 传统人群计数方法依赖网格化密度图，对空间分辨率敏感，难以连续、灵活地建模人群分布。
method: GDSNet将人群表示为连续2D高斯图元叠加；引入基于控制点的拟合机制，用控制点定义局部区域并池化特征以回归每个图元参数；同时将可微高斯泼溅适配到计数任务，每个图元由几何参数和标量密度质量参数化，通过可微渲染密度图的空间匹配进行端到端训练，兼具局部密度监督与全局计数优化。
result: 在四个标准基准上开展了广泛评估，GDSNet一致优于当前最先进方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: GDSNet通过连续高斯图元与可微泼溅为人群计数提供了不依赖固定网格分辨率的端到端方案，其局部密度监督与全局计数优化结合有望提升复杂场景下的计数鲁棒性。

title: Argos: Adapt Rich Geometric Priors for Generalizable Online Scene-Change-Detection
abstract: Robots operating in dynamic environments require reliable detection of how their surroundings change over time. Existing learning-based methods largely rely on pairwise 2D image features, which struggle under large viewpoint changes and occlusions, are sensitive to noise, and show limited generalization across domains, while explicit 3D approaches typically require costly offline optimization. We show that the implicit 3D knowledge of Geometric Foundation Models (GFMs) provides a strong basis for addressing these limitations. We introduce Argos, which adapts GFM features for joint scene change detection and 3D reconstruction. To address data scarcity and take a step toward a foundation model for scene change detection, we introduce a large-scale benchmark comprising two synthetic datasets and one real-world dataset, and train jointly across diverse datasets to improve cross-domain generalization. We further introduce Argos-SLAM, a real-time system designed for robotics, which performs online change detection and change-aware 4D mapping. Across benchmarks, our framework substantially outperforms existing baselines, with gains of up to 42.01% in change IoU and 27.91% in F1, while supporting scalable deployment in changing real-world environments.
tldr: Argos 基于几何基础模型的隐式3D先验，实现在线场景变化检测与变化感知4D建图。
motivation: 动态环境中的机器人需要可靠检测环境随时间发生的变化。现有学习方法多依赖成对2D图像特征，在大视角变化和遮挡下性能下降、对噪声敏感且跨域泛化有限，而显式3D方法通常需要昂贵的离线优化。
method: Argos 将几何基础模型（GFM）特征适配到场景变化检测与3D重建联合任务中。为缓解数据稀缺并迈向场景变化检测基础模型，作者构建了包含两个合成数据集和一个真实数据集的大规模基准，并跨多样数据集联合训练以提升跨域泛化。进一步提出面向机器人的实时系统 Argos-SLAM，支持在线变化检测和变化感知4D建图。
result: 在多个基准上，该框架显著优于现有基线，变化IoU提升最高达42.01%，F1提升最高达27.91%，并支持在动态真实环境中的可扩展部署。
conclusion: 结果表明GFM的隐式3D知识可为通用在线场景变化检测提供强基础，贡献了大规模基准、联合训练策略和实时机器人系统，有望推动变化感知4D建图在真实动态环境中的落地。

title: DeltaSplat: Iterative Gaussian Refinement for Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructs a scene from sparse, unposed images in a single network pass, removing the need for camera calibration and per-scene optimization. However, camera estimation errors propagate into the predicted Gaussians and compound the geometric and photometric inaccuracies of single-pass prediction. To correct these errors, we introduce DeltaSplat, a lightweight Gaussian refinement module for pose-free feed-forward 3DGS. It iteratively renders the current Gaussians at the input context views and predicts per-Gaussian updates from the resulting residuals. A 2D residual alone, however, underdetermines the 3D correction. DeltaSplat therefore conditions each update on per-pixel Plücker rays and rendered depth as a soft geometric prior. A dual-branch convolutional mixer efficiently encodes these inputs, and per-attribute heads decode the fused features into position, opacity, and color updates. The module adds only ~2.2% parameters to the backbone and remains fully feed-forward at inference. On DL3DV, DeltaSplat reaches 26.64 dB PSNR in the pose-free setting, improving its state-of-the-art backbone by 1.75 dB and surpassing even baselines supplied with ground-truth cameras; consistent gains hold across 6-24 views and all camera regimes.
tldr: DeltaSplat用迭代残差与Plücker射线/深度先验修正无位姿前馈3DGS的相机与几何光度误差。
motivation: 无位姿前馈3DGS可在单次网络前向中从稀疏未标定图像重建场景，但相机估计误差会传播到预测的Gaussian，并放大单次预测的几何与光度不准确问题。因此需要在保持前馈效率的前提下迭代修正这些误差。
method: DeltaSplat是一个轻量Gaussian细化模块：在输入上下文视角迭代渲染当前Gaussian，并根据渲染残差预测每个Gaussian的更新。由于2D残差无法唯一确定3D修正，它引入逐像素Plücker射线与渲染深度作为软几何先验，通过双分支卷积混合器编码，再由属性头解码位置、不透明度和颜色更新；仅增加约2.2%参数，推理仍完全前馈。
result: 在DL3DV的无位姿设置下，DeltaSplat达到26.64 dB PSNR，比其最优骨干提升1.75 dB，并超过使用真值相机的基线；在6-24视角和所有相机配置下均取得一致增益。
conclusion: 结果表明，迭代Gaussian细化能有效纠正无位姿前馈3DGS中的误差，在保持完全前馈推理的同时显著提升重建质量，并缩小甚至超越依赖真值相机的方法。

title: WAPR: A Foundation Model for Wide-Angle Refinement in Unseen Object Pose Estimation
abstract: Real-world applications require 6D pose estimation to be accurate, fast, and scalable to unseen objects. This paper introduces WAPR, a zero-shot wide-angle pose refinement model that refines candidate poses with rotational deviations up to 90 degrees. With as few as 12 candidate poses per detected object instance, WAPR supports fast inference within 1 s per frame and reaches a pose-estimation throughput of up to 25 detected object instances per second. To support wide-angle training for rotationally symmetric objects, WAPR uses rotational symmetry priors to canonicalize symmetry-equivalent pose targets before loss computation. We further construct SA6D, a large-scale 6D training dataset with such priors. SA6D obtains KASAL-assisted rotational symmetry priors for 944 GSO scans and expands them through geometry and texture augmentation into about 50K augmented object instances and about 2M rendered RGB-D images. In addition, an angle-balanced loss stabilizes learning across different angular ranges by reducing the influence of uninformative large-error cases. Experiments on seven BOP core datasets show that WAPR achieves state-of-the-art performance in unseen-object 6D pose localization and detection under both fast and unconstrained inference settings. Project page: https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/WAPR.
tldr: WAPR是面向未见物体的零样本宽角度6D位姿精化基础模型，支持90°旋转偏差且推理快速并达到SOTA。
motivation: 真实应用要求6D位姿估计兼具准确性、快速性和对未见物体的可扩展性，而大角度旋转偏差下的候选位姿精化仍是关键挑战。
method: WAPR是一种零样本宽角度位姿精化模型，可精化旋转偏差达90°的候选位姿，并仅需每个检测实例12个候选位姿即可快速推理。它利用旋转对称先验在损失计算前规范化对称等价位姿目标，并构建SA6D大规模6D训练数据集：通过KASAL辅助获得944个GSO扫描的对称先验，经几何与纹理增强扩展到约5万实例和约200万RGB-D图像。此外，角度平衡损失通过降低无信息大误差样本的影响来稳定不同角度范围的学习。
result: 在7个BOP核心数据集上，WAPR在快速与无约束推理设置下均取得未见物体6D位姿定位与检测的SOTA性能。其每帧推理时间低于1s，吞吐量最高达每秒25个检测物体实例，且每实例仅需12个候选位姿。
conclusion: WAPR为未见物体的宽角度6D位姿精化提供了可扩展的零样本基础模型，并通过SA6D数据集与角度平衡损失提升了对称物体和大角度偏差下的训练稳定性，有望推动真实场景中快速、鲁棒的6D位姿估计应用。

title: KASALv2: Fully Automatic 3D Rotational Symmetry Classification and Axis Localization
abstract: Rotational symmetry is an important prior in 6D pose estimation, improving pose accuracy and supporting symmetry-aware evaluation. However, current symmetry annotations for 3D objects remain largely manual or semi-automatic, often requiring predefined types or orders, which limits scalability. This work introduces a fully automatic, reference-free framework for symmetry-type classification, rotational-order identification, and full-axis localization across all eight canonical 3D rotational symmetry types. The method localizes a dominant high-order axis, infers its rotational order through self-consistency analysis, and reconstructs the complete symmetry structure under a hierarchy-guided formulation. A texture-aware extension further models appearance-induced reductions in rotational order while preserving axis orientations. Experiments on idealized and real-world datasets demonstrate strong accuracy and generalization, achieving 94.75% accuracy on 438 symmetric objects in GSO. Training FoundationPose with these priors improves accuracy by up to 0.9% across five BOP datasets, showing that automatically estimated rotational priors improve downstream 6D pose estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/KASAL.
tldr: KASALv2实现全自动无参考的3D旋转对称分类与轴定位，并可提升6D位姿估计。
motivation: 旋转对称是6D位姿估计的重要先验，可提升位姿精度并支持对称感知评估，但现有3D物体对称标注依赖人工或半自动流程且常需预定义对称类型与阶数，难以规模化。
method: KASALv2是一个全自动、无参考框架，覆盖八类规范3D旋转对称：先定位主导高阶轴，再通过自一致性分析推断旋转阶数，并在层次引导下重建完整对称结构。其纹理感知扩展进一步建模外观导致的旋转阶数降低，同时保持轴方向不变。
result: 在理想与真实数据集上，方法展现出较强精度和泛化能力；在GSO的438个对称物体上达到94.75%准确率。使用其先验训练FoundationPose后，在五个BOP数据集上位姿精度最高提升0.9%。
conclusion: 该工作实现了可扩展的自动对称分类、阶数识别与轴定位，证明自动估计的旋转先验能有效改进下游6D位姿估计，并可为对称感知评估提供支持。代码已开源。

title: RLHND: Video Foundation Models as Physically Grounded Hand Trackers for Robot Learning
abstract: Recently, approaches that leverage human video datasets for robot policy training have become increasingly prevalent. However, most existing hand trackers regress pose from cropped frames with limited priors on hand motion and object interaction, resulting in inaccurate and physically inconsistent estimates. Moreover, the lack of physical cues, e.g., contact and force, limits the use of human videos for robot policy training. To this end, we propose RLHND, a video foundation model-based hand tracking model that jointly estimates hand pose and realistic tactile information from monocular egocentric videos. RLHND turns the pre-trained Cosmos 3 video diffusion backbone into a deterministic clip-level feature extractor via clean-latent conditioning, carrying its learned priors on hand motion and hand-object interaction into tracking. For pose estimation, RLHND (i) predicts hand poses with anatomically plausible joint angles and (ii) enables optional conditioning on the shape parameter to maintain consistent hand shape within the same video and even across videos recorded by the same actor. For tactile estimation, a separate tactile expert stream, trained with the pose stream frozen, predicts dense contact and force over the hand surface. We further adopt LBS-based feature spreading to enable vertex-wise feature extraction without costly per-vertex attention. RLHND achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmark datasets for pose estimation, while also achieving state-of-the-art performance in contact and force estimation. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of RLHND for robot learning through retargeting results and real-world robot experiments. The code will be publicly available at https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/.
tldr: RLHND将视频基础模型转为确定性特征提取器，联合估计手部姿态与触觉并用于机器人学习。
motivation: 现有手部跟踪器多从裁剪帧回归姿态，缺乏手部运动与物体交互先验，导致估计不准确且物理不一致；同时缺少接触和力等物理线索，限制了人类视频在机器人策略训练中的使用。
method: RLHND将预训练Cosmos 3视频扩散骨干通过clean-latent conditioning转为确定性clip级特征提取器，以继承手部运动与手物交互先验。姿态流预测解剖合理的关节角并支持可选形状参数条件以保持同一演员手形一致；独立触觉专家流在冻结姿态流下预测手表面密集接触与力，并采用LBS-based feature spreading实现顶点级特征提取。
result: RLHND在多个姿态估计基准上达到SOTA，在接触和力估计上也达到SOTA；通过重定向结果和真实机器人实验验证了其对机器人学习的实用性。
conclusion: RLHND表明视频基础模型可作为物理接地的单目自我中心手部跟踪器，同时输出姿态与触觉信息，从而拓展人类视频用于机器人策略训练。代码将公开于项目页面。

title: PPCAR-Net: Projection-Refined Parametric 3D Coronary Artery Reconstruction from Sparse X-ray Angiographic Views
abstract: Sparse-view 3D coronary reconstruction commonly relies on cross-view correspondence and triangulation, which are vulnerable to vessel overlap and foreshortening, or on volumetric prediction followed by vascular-graph extraction, which does not directly provide centrelines and radii. We introduce PPCAR-Net, a projection-refined parametric coronary artery reconstruction network that directly predicts a branch-structured centreline-and-radius representation without explicit point matching, triangulation, or an intermediate volume. Given a variable number of segmented views, a coarse predictor combines frozen VGGT features with learned branch queries to estimate branch presence, B-spline centreline trajectories, and dense radius profiles. Projection-guided geometry and radius refiners then sample local evidence from the input views and apply residual corrections learned with 3D supervision. We evaluate representation fidelity and sparse-view reconstruction quantitatively and qualitatively. On simulated angiographic masks generated from CT-derived coronary anatomy, PPCAR-Net produces better connected artery reconstructions and achieves strong centreline accuracy, particularly for RCA, while maintaining competitive volumetric overlap. Coarse-to-fine inference takes 121 ms, enabling real-time reconstruction.
tldr: 提出PPCAR-Net，从稀疏X射线血管造影视图直接预测分支结构的中心线和半径参数化表示，实现实时3D冠状动脉重建。
motivation: 现有稀疏视图3D冠状动脉重建方法或依赖易受血管重叠和透视缩短影响的跨视图对应与三角测量，或依赖体积预测后提取血管图，无法直接提供中心线和半径。
method: 提出PPCAR-Net，直接从可变数量的分割视图预测分支结构的中心线和半径表示，无需显式点匹配、三角测量或中间体积。粗预测器结合冻结VGGT特征与可学习分支查询估计分支存在性、B样条中心线轨迹和稠密半径剖面；投影引导的几何与半径细化器从输入视图采样局部证据，并利用3D监督学习残差修正。
result: 在CT衍生的冠状动脉解剖生成的模拟血管造影掩膜上，PPCAR-Net生成更连通的动脉重建，中心线精度高（尤其RCA），体积重叠具有竞争力；粗到细推理耗时121 ms，实现实时重建。
conclusion: PPCAR-Net通过参数化表示和投影细化，避免了显式匹配与中间体积，在稀疏视图下实现高精度实时冠状动脉重建，为临床介入提供了潜在应用。

title: TileSkipper: Region-Adaptive Tile Pruning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Tiled 3D Gaussian Splatting rasterizers often use one scene-wide contribution cutoff for tile enumeration, although content differs in its sensitivity to support truncation. TileSkipper selects a static per-Gaussian cutoff policy for a frozen checkpoint. Calibration renders measure candidate pair savings and an isolated-removal distortion proxy that accounts for front transmittance and background color. The method allocates cutoffs across 64 Gaussian groups and accepts policies only after complete renders on disjoint selection views. The exported policy uses one byte per Gaussian, with no parameter updates, additional kernel, or per-frame policy inference. Across 13 scenes from Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks & Temples, and Deep Blending, a fixed-policy AccuTile sweep gives dataset-macro speedups of $1.088\times$ at standard resolution and $1.238\times$ at 3840 pixels wide, with $-0.007/-0.023$ dB mean PSNR change. Six integrations with existing opacity-aware bounds yield $1.009\times$--$1.121\times$ compiler-only speedups. For four ports from $3σ$ rasterizers, we separately attribute the prior exact-bound transition and our incremental gain. Matched-quality ablations show modest gains over scene-global calibration and parity with per-Gaussian control; the standalone comparison with AdaGScale is regime-dependent.
tldr: TileSkipper通过区域自适应瓦片修剪，在几乎不掉PSNR下实现最高1.238倍渲染加速。
motivation: 现有分块3D高斯泼溅光栅化器通常对整个场景使用统一的贡献度截断阈值来枚举瓦片，但不同区域内容对支撑截断的敏感度差异很大，统一阈值难以兼顾速度与质量。TileSkipper旨在为冻结检查点选择区域自适应的截断策略，减少冗余瓦片-高斯对。
method: TileSkipper为冻结检查点选择静态的逐高斯截断策略：通过校准渲染测量候选瓦片-高斯对节省量和考虑前向透射率与背景色的孤立移除失真代理，并在64个高斯组间分配截断阈值，仅在互斥选择视图上完整渲染后才接受策略。导出策略每个高斯仅占1字节，不更新参数、不增加额外核函数、也不进行逐帧策略推断。
result: 在Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks & Temples和Deep Blending的13个场景上，固定策略AccuTile扫描在标准分辨率下取得1.088倍数据集宏平均加速，3840像素宽下取得1.238倍加速，平均PSNR仅变化-0.007/-0.023 dB。与现有不透明度感知边界结合的6种集成取得1.009–1.121倍仅编译器加速；匹配质量消融显示相对场景全局校准有适度增益，与逐高斯控制相当，与AdaGScale的独立比较依配置而异。
conclusion: TileSkipper以极低存储与运行时开销实现区域自适应瓦片修剪，可兼容现有边界优化并显著加速高分辨率3D高斯泼溅渲染，同时保持近乎无损的画质，具备实际部署潜力。

title: Hardware-aware Calibrated Clustered Attention for Efficient Visual Geometric Transformers
abstract: The Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) marks a significant leap forward in 3D scene reconstruction, as it is the first model that directly infers all key 3D attributes (camera poses, depths, and dense geometry) jointly in one pass. However, this joint inference mechanism requires global attention layers with extremely long sequences that causes a significant latency bottleneck. In this paper, we propose blockwise clustered attention (BC attention) to accelerate the global attention layers in VGGT. By limiting the clustering within HW-friendly neighborhood blocks, BC attention reduces the computation overhead of query clustering as well as the costly data movement between on- and off-chip memory. This enables BC attention to scale to long sequences and deliver practical latency improvements on GPUs. Moreover, we introduce a hashing hyperplane calibration method and a threshold-based error compensation method to reduce clustering errors efficiently, which is a bottleneck in the current clustered attention mechanism. Overall, our experiments on GPU demonstrate that calibrated BC attention accelerates the global attention layers by 2.10-2.63$\times$ and the whole backbone by 1.77-2.35$\times$ with negligible loss (1%) for large scenes. With a small performance loss (< 5%), calibrated BC attention further achieves a 2.26-2.87$\times$ latency improvement on the global attention layers and a 1.90-2.55$\times$ improvement on the backbone.
tldr: 提出块状聚类注意力BC attention与校准补偿，加速VGGT全局注意力并显著降低延迟，精度损失小。
motivation: VGGT 能一次联合推断相机位姿、深度和密集几何等关键 3D 属性，但其联合推理依赖超长序列全局注意力，造成显著延迟瓶颈。现有聚类注意力存在查询聚类开销大、片上与片外数据移动成本高、聚类误差大等问题，难以在 GPU 上高效扩展至长序列。
method: 提出块状聚类注意力（BC attention），将聚类限制在硬件友好的邻域块内，从而降低查询聚类计算量以及片上/片外内存间的数据移动开销。同时引入哈希超平面校准与基于阈值的误差补偿方法，高效降低聚类误差。
result: 在 GPU 实验中，校准后的 BC attention 将全局注意力层加速 2.10–2.63×、整个 backbone 加速 1.77–2.35×，大场景精度损失仅约 1%。在小于 5% 性能损失下，全局注意力层和 backbone 分别进一步达到 2.26–2.87× 与 1.90–2.55× 的延迟改进。
conclusion: 校准 BC attention 在精度损失可忽略或较小的情况下显著加速 VGGT 的全局注意力层与整体骨干网络，使长序列视觉几何 Transformer 在 GPU 上更具实用效率，为高效 3D 场景重建部署提供了新方案。

title: Post-Training Semantic Lifting for 3D Gaussian Splatting: Separating Detector, Lifting and Representation Error
abstract: The same Gaussian of a 3D Gaussian Splatting model is seen from many views, and these views do not always agree on the class it belongs to. The Gaussian may be occluded in some of them, and the confidence of the detector is not the same from one view to another. The ground truth, on the other hand, is given as an annotated mesh, because two training runs do not produce the same Gaussians. In this work, we propose a post-training lifting method that works with one target class at a time and combines the information coming from all the views. Target and non-target evidence are accumulated simultaneously, weighted by the visibility of each Gaussian in each view. After that, the Gaussians are filtered with two thresholds: a main threshold $β$ selects the high-confidence seeds, and a lower one $γβ$ adds the connected components around them. For the evaluation, the labels are transferred from the Gaussians to the mesh vertices that are both visible and annotated. With this design, we can separate three sources of error: the 2D detector, the lifting and the transfer between representations. The thresholds and the transfer operator are chosen on seven Replica validation scenes, and the method is evaluated on ten held-out ScanNet++ scenes with the same values for every scene and class. The mean mIoU on the validation scenes was 0.93 with masks from the dataset annotations and 0.65 with YOLO masks, and on the ScanNet++ test scenes it was 0.80 and 0.54. Compared with thresholding the evidence per view, as a previous version of the method did, the fraction improves the test mIoU by 0.24 and makes it possible to use a single threshold for all the classes and scenes of both datasets. Finally, the error analysis shows that most of the remaining error comes from the detector.
tldr: 提出后训练语义提升方法，融合多视角可见性加权证据与双阈值滤波，将3DGS语义标签迁移到网格并分离误差来源。
motivation: 3DGS中同一高斯在多视角下类别标注常不一致，且遮挡与检测器置信度变化使语义提升不可靠；同时因两次训练产生的高斯不同，真值需以带标注网格给出，因此需要一种后训练、跨视角聚合且便于分离误差的方法。
method: 对每个目标类，同时累积所有视角的目标与非目标证据，并按每个高斯在各视角中的可见性加权；随后用主阈值β选取高置信种子，再用较低阈值γβ加入其周围连通分量。评估时将高斯标签迁移到同时可见且被标注的网格顶点，从而分离2D检测器、语义提升和表示迁移三类误差。
result: 在7个Replica验证场景上选择阈值与迁移算子，并在10个held-out ScanNet++测试场景中使用同一组参数。Replica验证平均mIoU为0.93（数据集标注掩码）和0.65（YOLO掩码），ScanNet++测试为0.80和0.54；相比逐视角证据阈值化，测试mIoU提升0.24，并可跨数据集所有类别与场景使用单一阈值。
conclusion: 该方法有效提升了3DGS后训练语义提升的鲁棒性与跨场景泛化能力，并提供了分解检测器、提升和表示误差的评测框架；误差分析表明剩余误差主要来自2D检测器，提示未来应优先改进检测器质量。

title: VOMMI: Collecting and Leveraging Portable Demonstrations for Mobile Manipulation
abstract: Portable mobile-manipulation demonstrations can help alleviate data scarcity for embodied intelligence, but obtaining reliable, low-cost, and robot-free motion supervision from RGB observations remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on teleoperation or specialized devices equipped with additional sensing hardware, while directly using estimated visual odometry (VO) trajectories can introduce inconsistencies due to accumulated drift and imperfect motion supervision. We present the Visual-Odometry-Conditioned Mobile Manipulation Interface (VOMMI), a portable demonstration collection and learning framework that connects portable RGB demonstrations to vision-language-action (VLA) post-training through offline trajectory reconstruction and online visual-motion conditioning. VOMMI synchronizes body and hand views to capture navigation context and local object interactions without requiring human-robot kinematic correspondence calibration. R2-VO refines offline demonstration trajectories using sparse geometric anchors and produces causal local-motion tokens over multiple prediction horizons for online policy conditioning. An action-group residual adapter incorporates these tokens only into the base branch. Experiments use a 500-trajectory portable for each task, with 75 trajectories held out for RGB-VO evaluation, and 200 robot demonstrations as references. Our policy, post-trained only on portable demonstrations, achieves 18.2% lower base-velocity error than a policy trained with robot-collected demonstrations, while maintaining comparable end-effector translation accuracy. Offline reconstruction reduces absolute trajectory errors for the body and hand streams by 24.6% on average relative to the best evaluated baseline for each stream. The complete system improves the mean success rate by 8.3 percentage points over OpenPI 0.5 across three real-robot tasks.
tldr: VOMMI通过视觉里程计条件化，从便携RGB演示中重建轨迹并后训练VLA，提升移动操作性能。
motivation: 便携式移动操作演示可缓解具身智能的数据稀缺问题，但现有方法多依赖遥操作或带额外传感硬件的专用设备，且直接使用估计的视觉里程计轨迹会因累积漂移和不完美运动监督产生不一致。该工作旨在实现低成本、无需机器人运动学对应标定、仅凭RGB观测的可靠运动监督。
method: 提出VOMMI框架，同步身体与手部视角以捕获导航上下文和局部物体交互，无需人-机器人运动学对应标定。R2-VO利用稀疏几何锚点离线精炼演示轨迹，并生成多预测时域的因果局部运动token用于在线策略条件化；动作组残差适配器仅将这些token注入基础分支。
result: 每个任务使用500条便携轨迹，其中75条用于RGB-VO评估，并以200条机器人演示为参考。仅用便携演示后训练的策略比用机器人演示训练的策略基座速度误差低18.2%，末端执行器平移精度相当；离线重建使身体和手部流的绝对轨迹误差相对各自最佳基线平均降低24.6%；在三个真实机器人任务上，完整系统平均成功率比OpenPI 0.5提升8.3个百分点。
conclusion: VOMMI表明，便携RGB演示结合离线轨迹重建与在线视觉运动条件化，可有效后训练VLA策略，并减少对机器人演示和遥操作设备的依赖。该框架为移动操作的数据采集与策略学习提供了可扩展、低成本的路径。

title: RACE-FPP: A Robust AI-assisted Characterisation Enhancement for Fringe Projection Profilometry
abstract: Fringe Projection Profilometry (FPP) requires precise system characterisation to achieve reliable three-dimensional (3D) reconstructions; however, characterisation accuracy strongly depends on robust checkerboard feature localisation, which can deteriorate under challenging imaging conditions such as lens blur and characterisation target orientations. Existing deep learning-based corner detectors are typically assessed using detection metrics and camera reprojection error alone, without considering their wider impact on projector characterisation, camera-projector stereo characterisation consistency, or overall measurement accuracy. In this work, we introduce a complete FPP characterisation pipeline that incorporates deep learning-based corner detection into the standard camera characterisation workflow. We also characterise the projector by sampling phase values at the centres of the white squares in the characterisation target. Rather than treating corner detection as an isolated task, the proposed framework explicitly analyses how localisation errors propagate throughout the entire FPP characterisation chain. Performance is evaluated using detection metrics (e.g., precision and recall), camera and projector reprojection errors, and the camera and projector stereo characterisation. Across a mixed dataset of clean and degraded images, the camera reprojection error is reduced from 1.237 pixels to 0.259 pixels, while the projector reprojection error is reduced by roughly 50%. Dimensional evaluation of reconstructed artefacts shows improved geometric accuracy compared with those resulting from the conventional pipeline. Overall, the findings indicate increased robustness of system-level characterisation under challenging imaging conditions, thereby enabling more reliable industrial FPP measurements.
tldr: 提出RACE-FPP，将深度学习角点检测融入FPP标定流程，降低重投影误差并提升三维测量鲁棒性。
motivation: FPP需要精确系统标定，但标定精度依赖棋盘格角点定位，在镜头模糊与目标姿态变化等挑战成像条件下易退化；现有深度学习角点检测器仅用检测指标和相机重投影误差评估，未考虑其对投影仪标定、相机-投影仪立体标定一致性及整体测量精度的影响。
method: 提出完整FPP标定流程，将深度学习角点检测集成到标准相机标定工作流；通过采样标定板白色方格中心的相位值来标定投影仪；并显式分析局部定位误差在FPP标定链中的传播。
result: 在干净与退化混合数据集上，相机重投影误差从1.237像素降至0.259像素，投影仪重投影误差约降低50%；重建工件的尺寸评估显示几何精度优于传统流程。
conclusion: 该方法在挑战成像条件下提升系统级标定鲁棒性，使工业FPP测量更可靠；贡献在于将角点检测评估从孤立任务扩展到全标定链影响分析，并给出端到端增强方案。

title: DensiTok: Making Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting See More Views Than It Is Given
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructs a scene in a single forward pass, replacing per-scene optimization with a network trained across many scenes. Its quality, however, degrades sharply as the number of input images drops. The bottleneck is upstream of the reconstruction heads: from a few unposed views, the internal representation they read carries no evidence for unobserved regions, leaving holes, floaters, and blur. The common remedy supplies that evidence as pixels, synthesizing extra views with an image or video generator and re-encoding them, which is costly and not 3D-consistent by construction. We instead densify the evidence itself. We present DensiTok, a plug-in module for pretrained feed-forward 3DGS models that densifies their internal geometry tokens directly, making a frozen backbone behave as though it had observed many more views than it was given. DensiTok compresses those tokens into a compact latent space, completes the latents of the unobserved viewpoints in a single flow-matching step conditioned on camera geometry, and decodes them back into tokens that the original reconstruction heads. The same module design can be integrated into different pretrained predictors while keeping each backbone and its reconstruction heads frozen. Completion in a low-dimensional latent space requires no image synthesis or additional encoder passes. Across three pretrained backbones and two benchmarks, DensiTok consistently improves sparse-view reconstruction and recovers much of the gap to dense-view reconstruction.
tldr: DensiTok通过在低维隐空间补全几何token，使冻结的前馈3DGS在稀疏视角下重建更完整。
motivation: 前馈3DGS可在单次前向中重建场景，但随着输入图像数量减少，重建质量急剧下降；其瓶颈在重建头之前：少量无位姿视图提供的内部表示缺乏未观测区域的证据，导致空洞、漂浮物和模糊。现有补救方法合成额外视图像素并重新编码，成本高且不具3D一致性。
method: DensiTok是一种即插即用模块，直接对预训练前馈3DGS模型的内部几何token进行致密化：将token压缩到紧凑隐空间，以相机几何为条件通过单步流匹配补全未观测视角的隐变量，再解码回token供原重建头使用。整个过程中骨干网络和重建头保持冻结，无需图像合成或额外编码器前向。
result: 在三个预训练骨干和两个基准上，DensiTok一致提升稀疏视角重建质量，并缩小与稠密视角重建的差距。摘要未提供PSNR、SSIM等具体量化数值。
conclusion: DensiTok通过致密化内部证据而非生成像素，为前馈3DGS提供骨干无关、可插拔的稀疏视角增强方案，有望推动高效稀疏视角3D高斯重建。

title: Revar3r: gauge-aware perturbation uncertainty for feed-forward 3d reconstruction
abstract: A correctly reconstructed distant point appears uncertain even when a frozen 3D model processes equivalent inputs because its output frame rotates fractionally. This exposes a weakness of trainingfree perturbation uncertainty: when outputs contain an unobserved symmetry, run-to-run variation potentially reflects symmetry rather than error. Existing alternatives have trade-offs: built-in confidence is outperformed in most evaluated conditions, while trained evidential heads require modelspecific supervision. For point maps, this research derives a closed-form, error-independent variance term that grows with scene extent and potentially overwhelms the desired signal. Simulation reproduces the effect; all 30 real VGGT view-sets tested exhibit its predicted $\|x_p\|^2$ signature. ReVar3R robustly registers predictions to a common similarity frame before computing per-point variance, without retraining or modifying the frozen model. Optional calibration and fusion use a held-out split. Across VGGT, π3, and MASt3R on six datasets, the same estimator on every backbone lowers AUSE below built-in confidence in 15 of 18 conditions. The staged evaluation yields 11 of 18 wins for the label-free core, 12/18 for label-free equal-weight fusion, 14/18 with held-out weights, and 15/18 when the built-in signal is included. Against a trained evidential head, the result is a trade-off: the head calibrates magnitude better and leads in its training domain, whereas ReVar3R transfers across backbones without adaptation. Its ranking improves point filtering, but it does not detect stable systematic bias, aid novel-view synthesis, or transfer calibration across domains.
tldr: ReVar3R通过对齐到公共相似框架，消除规范对称性引起的虚假扰动，实现免训练逐点不确定性估计。
motivation: 在冻结前馈3D模型中，输出坐标系微小旋转会使正确远点看似不确定，导致训练自由扰动不确定性把未观测对称性引起的运行间变化误当误差；点图还存在随场景范围增长、与误差无关的闭式方差项会淹没信号。现有内置置信度多数条件下表现不佳，而训练evidential head需要模型特定监督。
method: ReVar3R在计算逐点方差前，将预测鲁棒配准到公共相似框架，以消除规范与坐标系对称性，不重训也不修改冻结模型；可选校准与融合使用留出划分。对点图推导闭式、误差无关的方差项，并解释其随x_p模长平方增长的特征。
result: 在VGGT、π3、MASt3R和六个数据集上，同一估计器在18个条件中的15个将AUSE降至内置置信度以下；分阶段评估中，无标签核心胜出11/18，等权融合12/18，留出权重14/18，加入内置信号15/18。仿真复现了虚假方差效应，且全部30组真实VGGT视图集呈现预测签名。与训练evidential head相比，后者幅度校准更好且在其训练域领先，而ReVar3R无需适配即可跨骨干迁移。
conclusion: ReVar3R贡献在于免训练、模型无关且可跨骨干迁移的逐点不确定性，并可改善点过滤排序；但它不能检测稳定系统偏差、不能辅助新视角合成，也不能跨域迁移校准。

title: Efficient Gaussian Splatting Sequence Compression with Standard Video Codecs
abstract: This paper presents a novel effective Gaussian Splatting (GS) sequence Compression method that utilizes the Video codec (GSCV). Existing video-based GS sequence compression relies on the Parallel Linear Assignment Sorting (PLAS) and tracked primitive information to convert GS into smooth 2D videos. However, tracked information is not available for most practical applications, and without it, using the vanilla PLAS can generate images exhibiting weak inter-frame correlation, due to its stochastic nature. GSCV incorporates a simple yet efficient Inter-PLAS method to produce close images between the I- and P-frames of GS, enhancing the inter-frame performance of video codec greatly. GSCV also realizes a new pipeline based on the state-of-the-art video codecs with high bit-depth GS images, achieving higher compressibility while simultaneously providing a higher quality upper bound. Experimental results show that the proposed GSCV exhibits obviously improved performance over MPEG video and point cloud-based anchors in GS sequence compression. The code is available at https://github.com/Qi-Yangsjtu/GSCV.
tldr: 提出GSCV，用标准视频编解码器高效压缩高斯泼溅序列，无需跟踪信息并提升帧间相关性。
motivation: 现有基于视频的高斯泼溅序列压缩依赖 PLAS 与跟踪基元信息将 GS 转为平滑二维视频，但实际应用中通常无法获得跟踪信息，且原始 PLAS 的随机性会导致帧间相关性弱。
method: GSCV 提出简单高效的 Inter-PLAS，使 GS 的 I 帧与 P 帧图像更接近，从而显著提升视频编解码器的帧间预测性能；并构建基于先进视频编解码器的高位深 GS 图像新流程，兼顾更高压缩率与更高画质上限。
result: 实验表明 GSCV 在高斯泼溅序列压缩上明显优于 MPEG 视频锚点和基于点云的锚点；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: GSCV 为无需跟踪信息的高斯泼溅序列压缩提供了有效方案，并通过 Inter-PLAS 与视频编解码流程提升压缩性能，代码已开源，有望推动 GS 序列在实际场景中的存储与传输。

title: Image-Space Refraction Correction for Underwater 3D Reconstruction: Warping Flat-Port Views into Pinhole Perspective
abstract: Consumer-grade cameras in flat-port housings are widely used for underwater exploration and mapping of coral reefs and seafloor habitats due to their low cost and accessibility. However, refraction at flat-port interfaces causes bowl-shaped deformation in reconstructed scenes and camera trajectories, compromising the metric accuracy required for mapping and navigation. To remove the dominant refractive distortion before reconstruction, we introduce a physics-based refraction correction in image space. Our method is downstream-agnostic: the refraction-corrected images can be directly used as input to existing reconstruction and SLAM algorithms. We characterize the refractive distortion through ray-tracing simulations and validate our correction on two real underwater datasets with differing scene structures. Compared with conventional and refractive Structure-from-Motion (SfM), our approach removes reconstruction deformation while registering more frames and maintaining low reprojection error. The correction further generalizes across diverse reconstruction and VSLAM backends, demonstrating its broad applicability to downstream vision pipelines.
tldr: 提出图像空间折射校正，将平面端口水下图像变换为针孔透视，消除重建形变并兼容现有SfM与VSLAM。
motivation: 消费级相机配平面端口防水壳广泛用于珊瑚礁与海底栖息地水下探索和测绘，但平面端口界面折射会使重建场景和相机轨迹呈碗状形变，损害测绘与导航所需的度量精度。因此需在重建前消除主导性折射畸变。
method: 提出基于物理的图像空间折射校正方法，把平面端口视角图像变换为针孔透视，从而在下游重建前去除折射畸变。方法通过光线追踪仿真刻画折射畸变，且与下游算法无关，校正后图像可直接输入现有三维重建和SLAM流程。
result: 在两个场景结构不同的真实水下数据集上验证，相比传统SfM与折射SfM，本方法消除重建形变，同时配准更多帧并保持较低重投影误差；校正还可泛化到多种重建与VSLAM后端。摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: 该工作贡献了一种下游无关的图像空间折射校正方案，可提升平面端口水下三维重建与视觉SLAM的度量精度，并广泛适用于珊瑚礁和海底测绘等水下视觉管线。

title: OpenSplatGraph: From Dense Semantic Maps to Structured Scene Graphs for Open-Vocabulary Robot Perception
abstract: Dense 3D mapping with semantic understanding is essential for robotic perception in complex environments. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting-based mapping approaches enable high-fidelity geometry and efficient open-vocabulary perception, but typically represent semantics as unstructured feature fields that limit object-centric reasoning. In contrast, 3D scene graphs explicitly model objects and their relationships for structured reasoning, but are commonly constructed from sparse geometric representations that do not fully exploit dense semantic maps. In this work, we present OpenSplatGraph, a unified framework that constructs persistent 3D scene graphs directly from an online Gaussian-based open-vocabulary semantic map. The proposed framework augments the dense semantic map with a reliability-aware semantic field that maintains lightweight observation statistics for confidence-aware, query-conditioned object extraction. Extracted object instances are associated with persistent graph nodes, allowing object attributes and relationships to be incrementally updated across observations and queries. By tightly coupling dense semantic mapping with persistent object-centric representations, our framework supports both language-guided object grounding and structured relational reasoning while preserving the geometric fidelity of Gaussian-based mapping. Comprehensive evaluations on standard 3D scene understanding benchmarks and real-world robotic experiments demonstrate that OpenSplatGraph achieves competitive performance for online open-vocabulary perception and downstream robotic tasks. Project page: https://csiro-robotics.github.io/OpenSplatGraph.
tldr: 从在线高斯开放词汇语义地图直接构建持久3D场景图的统一框架，支持物体级与关系推理。
motivation: 复杂环境中机器人感知需要兼具语义理解的稠密3D建图，但现有基于3D高斯泼溅的建图方法多将语义表示为无结构特征场，难以进行以物体为中心的推理；而3D场景图虽能建模物体及其关系，却常由稀疏几何表示构建，未能充分利用稠密语义地图的信息。
method: 提出OpenSplatGraph统一框架，直接在在线高斯开放词汇语义地图上构建持久3D场景图；通过可靠性感知语义场维护轻量观测统计，实现置信度感知、查询条件化的物体提取，并将提取的物体实例关联为持久图节点，使物体属性与关系可随观测和查询增量更新，从而紧密耦合稠密语义建图与持久物体中心表示。
result: 在标准3D场景理解基准和真实机器人实验中，该框架在在线开放词汇感知与下游机器人任务上取得有竞争力的性能，并保持高斯建图的几何保真度；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作将稠密开放词汇语义建图与结构化场景图表示统一起来，同时支持语言引导的物体定位与结构化关系推理，为开放词汇机器人感知提供了一种可增量维护的持久表示方案，并已公开项目页面。

title: StyleFields: Multi-Scale AdaIN-Modulated Implicit SDFs for Coarse-to-Fine 3D Shape Reconstruction and Editing
abstract: We introduce StyleFields, a DeepSDF-based architecture for high-fidelity 3D reconstruction that enables controllable geometric style mixing: the coarse structure of one object can be combined with the fine-scale details of another. The core idea is depth-aware modulation: instead of a single global code, we inject latents via multi-level Adaptive Instance Normalization at several decoder depths, and supervise matching auxiliary heads with a coarse-to-fine schedule while gradually growing network depth. This aligns early layers with global shape and later layers with high-frequency detail, achieving content-style decoupling without part labels or adversarial training. StyleFields delivers faithful reconstructions, convincing cross-instance hybrids, and consistent gains in ablations over injection depth and supervision granularity. We further demonstrate a practical application in automotive aerodynamics: a learned surrogate drag predictor serves as a differentiable objective to optimize reconstructed cars, allowing targeted edits of global form or surface details by freezing the complementary latent stream. StyleFields offers a simple, effective recipe for controllable implicit reconstruction and downstream performance-driven design.
tldr: 提出 StyleFields，用多层级 AdaIN 调制隐式 SDF，实现粗到精重建、风格混合与气动编辑。
motivation: 需要在高保真 3D 重建中组合一个物体的粗结构与另一个物体的细尺度细节，并支持可控编辑。关键挑战是在无需部件标签或对抗训练的情况下实现内容与风格的解耦。
method: StyleFields 基于 DeepSDF，采用深度感知调制：在解码器多个深度通过多级 AdaIN 注入潜码，并以粗到细监督辅助头、逐步增加网络深度，使浅层对应全局形状、深层对应高频细节。冻结互补潜码流可分别编辑整体形态或表面细节，还可结合可微代理阻力预测器进行气动优化。
result: 方法能实现高保真重建和有说服力的跨实例混合，在注入深度与监督粒度消融中取得稳定增益。在汽车气动应用中，以可微代理阻力预测器为目标优化重建车辆，可实现全局造型或表面细节的有针对性编辑。
conclusion: StyleFields 为可控隐式重建和下游性能驱动设计提供简单有效的方案，无需部件标签或对抗训练，并能扩展到空气动力学优化等任务。

title: SPLATIFY: Reproduce, Discover, Innovate! From Papers and Ideas to Trainable 3DGS Code
abstract: The rapid growth of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) research demands significant effort to reimplement papers before building on them. We introduce SPLATIFY, a multi-agent framework that converts 3DGS papers into trainable gsplat-based implementations, where generic paper-to-code methods and frontier models fail. SPLATIFY achieves this through five innovations: (1) A context-free grammar for gsplat over a modular method template with extension points for losses, densification, rendering, and optimization, constraining synthesis so generated code satisfies gsplat's architectural invariants by construction. (2) Architectural elements for faithful reproduction: fork-aware citation recovery retrieving component-level code at function-level granularity, Graph-of-Thought synthesis in topological dependency order, RAG-guided in-context example selection from over 20 verified implementations, and visual feedback combining PSNR-guided regeneration, Gaussian-level structural checks, and VLM-driven patching. (3) Knowledge-driven compositional improvement that autonomously finds weaknesses and composes complementary regularizers, losses, and densification strategies to improve upon original results. (4) Interdisciplinary method discovery where agents retrieve physical priors from outside the 3DGS literature and compose them with rendering knowledge to produce methods for previously unaddressed scene types. (5) SPLATIFY-Bench, an evaluation framework across 30 diverse 3DGS papers. On papers without public code, SPLATIFY matches expert implementations while reducing development time from weeks to minutes, and through compositional discovery further improves PSNR by up to 2.4 dB. We additionally demonstrate novel methods for volumetric nebula rendering and other scientific domains, synthesized entirely by SPLATIFY.
tldr: SPLATIFY 用多智能体将 3DGS 论文自动转为可训练 gsplat 代码，并支持复现、组合改进与跨学科创新。
motivation: 3DGS 研究快速增长，但复现论文并在此基础上继续开发需耗费大量精力；通用论文到代码方法和前沿模型在 3DGS/gsplat 场景下均难以成功。
method: SPLATIFY 构建面向 gsplat 的上下文无关文法与模块化模板，限定损失、致密化、渲染和优化的扩展点，保证生成代码满足架构不变量；并通过 fork 感知引用恢复、拓扑依赖的 Graph-of-Thought 合成、基于 20+ 已验证实现的 RAG 示例选择，以及 PSNR 再生、高斯级结构检查和 VLM 修补的可视反馈，实现忠实复现。它还通过知识驱动组合改进和跨学科先验检索，自动发现互补正则、损失与致密化策略，并生成新方法。
result: 在 30 篇 3DGS 论文构成的 SPLATIFY-Bench 上，对无公开代码论文，SPLATIFY 性能匹配专家实现，将开发时间从数周缩短到数分钟，并通过组合发现使 PSNR 最高提升 2.4 dB；还合成了体积星云渲染等科学领域的新方法。
conclusion: SPLATIFY 证明多智能体与领域约束结合可自动复现、改进和发现 3DGS 方法，显著降低论文到可训练代码的门槛，并为跨学科 3DGS 创新提供新范式。

title: S2Tok: Streaming 3D Gaussian Reconstruction with Persistent Spatial Tokens
abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction requires more than a sequence of geometric predictions: it requires a persistent scene state that can incorporate new evidence and remain renderable as observations arrive. Latent spatial tokens offer a promising representation for this purpose, but constructing them from an image collection leaves open how to maintain them online, where each observation may both revisit known regions and reveal new content. We introduce S2Tok, a feed-forward framework that maintains a size-adaptive, persistent scene state from uncalibrated image streams. Its central idea is to distinguish updates to the existing representation from selective expansion. A spatially informed transformer integrates each incoming observation with the persistent scene tokens, while a learned admission module selectively expands the representation to limit redundant storage. A hierarchical decoder and Gaussian head convert the evolving state into non-pixel-aligned 3D Gaussians, enabling novel-view rendering without caching previous frames. Experiments across four benchmarks demonstrate competitive streaming rendering quality with compact Gaussian representations. These results support latent spatial tokens as a persistent computational state for online 3D reconstruction, combining learned scene updates with explicit Gaussian rendering.
tldr: S2Tok 用持久空间 token 流式重建 3D 高斯，支持无标定图像流在线更新与渲染。
motivation: 流式 3D 重建不仅需要几何预测，更需要可随观测持续更新并保持可渲染的持久场景状态。潜在空间 token 适合作为该状态，但从图像集合构建后如何在线维护仍是开放问题，因每条观测既可能重访已知区域也可能揭示新内容。
method: S2Tok 是一个前馈框架，从无标定图像流维护尺寸自适应的持久场景状态，核心是区分对已有表示的更新与选择性扩展。空间感知 Transformer 将新观测与持久场景 token 融合，学习到的准入模块选择性扩展表示以减少冗余存储；层级解码器与 Gaussian head 将演化状态转为非像素对齐的 3D 高斯，无需缓存历史帧即可新视角渲染。
result: 在四个基准上的实验表明，该方法以紧凑高斯表示取得有竞争力的流式渲染质量。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果支持将潜在空间 token 作为在线 3D 重建的持久计算状态，结合学习式场景更新与显式高斯渲染，为流式重建提供新思路。

title: Less Context, Better Geometry: Masked Geometric Encoder for Robust 3D Foundation Models
abstract: Recent progress in 3D foundation models has enabled rapid 3D reconstruction and camera calibration by leveraging learned 3D priors from vast amount of spatial data. However, the all-to-all global attention design leads to quadratic complexity and limits long-sequence inference; unconstrained cross-view interactions also can propagate unreliable evidence from occluded or visually similar but geometrically distant views. In this paper, We introduce a Masked Geometric Encoder (MGE), which promotes the learning of robust geometric representations under incomplete cross-view context. During training, MGE strategically drops frame tokens from global attention and distills from a pretrained full-context teacher model. This allows the model to learn an intrinsically richer per-frame representation while providing sufficient intermediate supervision to avoid performance degradation. Through extensive experiments, we show that MGE leads to much stronger performance under occlusion and doppelganger views while retaining high performance on standard benchmarks. Such a richer frame representation also leads to more effective token reduction during inference. To this end, we develop a novel Anchor-Guided Adaptive token merging technique that preserves representative anchor frames while jointly merging redundant tokens from the remaining views. Compared to other efficient inference approaches, we can achieve inference speedup while consistently maintaining higher reconstruction quality, particularly in limited-view settings.
tldr: 提出掩码几何编码器MGE，通过丢弃部分跨视角注意力并蒸馏全上下文教师，提升遮挡与相似视图下的3D重建鲁棒性和推理效率。
motivation: 现有3D基础模型依赖全对全局注意力，带来二次复杂度并限制长序列推理，且无约束跨视角交互会从遮挡或视觉相似但几何远离的视角传播不可靠证据。
method: 提出MGE，在训练时从全局注意力中策略性丢弃帧token，并从预训练全上下文教师模型蒸馏，以学习更丰富的单帧表征并借助中间监督避免性能退化；推理时采用锚点引导的自适应token合并，保留代表性锚帧并合并其余视角的冗余token。
result: 实验表明MGE在遮挡与doppelganger视图下性能显著更强，同时在标准基准上保持高性能；相比其他高效推理方法，可实现推理加速并持续保持更高重建质量，尤其在有限视角设置下，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: MGE通过不完整跨视角上下文学习鲁棒几何表征，提升3D基础模型在遮挡和易混淆视图下的鲁棒性，并借助锚点引导token合并实现高效推理，为长序列和有限视角场景提供更优精度-效率权衡。

title: GS-Pool: Object-Level Change Detection in 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Factories, museums and surveyors photograph the same space months apart and need to know which objects changed. When each visit is reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), a direct comparison of the two reconstructions does not answer this. Training is stochastic, so two reconstructions of an unchanged space never coincide, and the second visit is often a quick re-scan with far fewer photographs. We propose GS-Pool, which takes two independently reconstructed Gaussian fields of the same space and returns the changed objects in each, together with their masks. SAM2 masks of each visit's photographs are lifted onto the Gaussians that render them and merged into an object pool, so every decision is taken once per object in 3D. We introduce a photographic carrier, the 3DGS training loss of each input reconstruction against the other visit's photographs, backpropagated to the Gaussians that rendered each pixel. We combine it with GS-Diff's geometry and colour terms and our distilled DINOv3 features. This evidence is compared with that of the objects present in both visits, which sets a change threshold for each scene. On PASLCD, GS-Pool reaches mIoU/F1 scores of 0.751/0.846 against 0.644/0.758 for GS-Diff, the strongest prior method, a gain of 17%/12%. Its mIoU is also 36%, 40% and 57% above that of O-SCD, PlenoCI and MV-3DCD, and it reaches 0.855 mIoU on CL-Splats, 33% above MV-3DCD. Each changed object is returned as a set of Gaussians with the evidence behind its decision, which an inspector can review in 3D.
tldr: GS-Pool 通过对象池与多源证据融合，实现独立3DGS重建间的对象级三维变化检测。
motivation: 工厂、博物馆和测绘人员常需比对相隔数月拍摄的同一空间，并找出发生变化的物体；但两次访问分别用3DGS重建后，直接比较无法回答该问题。原因是训练具有随机性，未变化空间的两次重建也不会重合，且第二次访问常为照片远少于首次的快速重扫。
method: GS-Pool 输入同一空间的两套独立重建高斯场，输出各次访问中的变化物体及其掩码。方法用SAM2分割每次访问照片，将掩码提升到渲染对应像素的高斯并合并为对象池，使决策按3D对象进行；同时引入摄影载体——将一套重建对另一访照片的3DGS训练损失反传至渲染各像素的高斯，并与GS-Diff几何/颜色项及蒸馏DINOv3特征融合，再与两访共有物体的证据比较以逐场景设定变化阈值。
result: 在PASLCD上，GS-Pool取得mIoU/F1 0.751/0.846，优于最强先前方法GS-Diff的0.644/0.758，提升17%/12%；其mIoU还分别比O-SCD、PlenoCI、MV-3DCD高36%、40%、57%。在CL-Splats上达到0.855 mIoU，比MV-3DCD高33%。
conclusion: GS-Pool 解决了独立3DGS重建因随机性与视角差异难以直接比较的问题，实现了对象级3D变化检测。每个变化物体以高斯集合及其决策证据返回，便于检查员在3D中复核，并在多个数据集上显著超越先前方法。

title: VGGT-Bridge: Beyond Sequential Pose Graphs via Coarse-Stride Skip Edges
abstract: Feed-forward visual geometry transformers such as VGGT reconstruct dense 3D structure from images in a single forward pass, simplifying multi-view 3D reconstruction. However, their quadratic attention complexity makes them difficult to scale to long sequences with thousands of frames. Chunk-and-align frameworks address this by splitting a long sequence into overlapping chunks and stitching their local reconstructions into a pose graph. Yet existing methods connect only sequentially adjacent chunks, so small per-frame errors accumulate along the chain into large-scale drift. To move beyond sequential edges, we propose VGGT-Bridge, which adds long-range skip edges that directly constrain non-adjacent chunks without retraining. By running VGGT on sparsely sampled coarse chunks, each coarse chunk bridges distant fine chunks into a single direct constraint. We further turn VGGT's first-frame scale bias into a drift correction by feeding selected coarse chunks in reverse, and a loop-aware policy keeps this reversal compatible with existing loop closures. VGGT-Bridge reduces ATE by 28.3% on KITTI Odometry, 18.8% on Virtual KITTI, and 10.0% on Waymo Open over the SwiftVGGT baseline, achieving the best performance among all chunk-and-align methods.
tldr: VGGT-Bridge通过粗步长跳跃边连接非相邻分块，无需重训练即可抑制长序列重建漂移。
motivation: 前馈视觉几何Transformer如VGGT能单次前向重建稠密3D结构，但二次注意力复杂度使其难以扩展到数千帧的长序列。现有分块对齐框架仅连接序列相邻块，逐帧小误差沿链累积形成大尺度漂移。
method: 提出VGGT-Bridge，在分块姿态图中加入长程跳跃边，直接约束非相邻分块且无需重训练。方法对稀疏采样的粗粒度分块运行VGGT，使每个粗分块将远处精细分块桥接为单一直接约束；并将VGGT首帧尺度偏置通过反向输入选定粗分块转化为漂移校正，同时用闭环感知策略保持与现有闭环兼容。
result: 相比SwiftVGGT基线，VGGT-Bridge在KITTI Odometry上ATE降低28.3%，在Virtual KITTI上降低18.8%，在Waymo Open上降低10.0%，在所有分块对齐方法中取得最佳性能。
conclusion: 结果表明，引入非顺序长程约束可有效缓解分块重建中的漂移累积，提升长序列视觉几何重建与里程计精度，并为扩展前馈几何Transformer到大规模场景提供无需重训练的实用方案。

title: MaRO-GS: Mask-Robust Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting from Inconsistent Multi-view Masks
abstract: We address the challenge of accurate 3D object reconstruction from multi-view images in Gaussian Splatting. Existing object-level 3DGS methods reconstruct the entire scene rather than directly optimizing the target object, even when only the target object is needed, which incurs substantial computational overhead. They also rely on 2D segmentation masks to associate Gaussians with objects, but these masks are often inconsistent across views. Such inconsistencies corrupt Gaussian optimization and produce incorrectly supervised Gaussians that degrade object reconstruction fidelity. To overcome these limitations, we propose MaRO-GS, a 3DGS framework that directly optimizes target-object Gaussians from object-masked multi-view images and remains robust to inconsistent supervision. For reliable supervision, mask-reliability view filtering excludes unreliable views. Object-supported Gaussian density control suppresses Gaussians irrelevant to the target object and prevents background densification, while Silhouette-aligned Object Loss maintains object-focused optimization. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that MaRO-GS improves PSNR, segmentation accuracy, and computational efficiency, with the largest PSNR gain of 2.05 dB on the small-object LERF-Mask dataset.
tldr: MaRO-GS通过掩码可靠性视图过滤、对象支持密度控制和轮廓对齐损失，从多视图掩码图像直接优化目标对象，鲁棒应对掩码不一致。
motivation: 现有对象级3DGS方法重建整个场景而非直接优化目标对象，计算开销大；且依赖跨视图不一致的2D分割掩码，这些不一致会破坏高斯优化并产生错误监督，降低对象重建保真度。
method: MaRO-GS直接优化目标对象高斯，并引入掩码可靠性视图过滤排除不可靠视图，对象支持高斯密度控制抑制无关高斯和背景致密化，以及轮廓对齐对象损失保持对象聚焦优化。
result: 在多个数据集上，MaRO-GS提升了PSNR、分割精度和计算效率，在LERF-Mask小物体数据集上PSNR最大提升2.05 dB。
conclusion: MaRO-GS实现了从多视图不一致掩码中鲁棒重建目标对象，提升了重建质量和效率，为对象级3DGS提供了有效解决方案。

title: Toward Reliable Infant Pose Estimation: A Training-Dynamics Approach to Noisy Annotation Detection
abstract: Spontaneous movement analysis in preterm infants relies increasingly on markerless pose estimation (PE) to derive clinically relevant motion biomarkers directly from video recordings. Training accurate infant PE models requires large sets of manually annotated keypoints, and human annotation is inherently prone to error. Noisy keypoints (i.e., keypoints mislocalized with respect to their true anatomical position) are especially problematic in this clinical setting, since they can propagate as artificial artifacts into the reconstructed joint trajectories. Building on the small-loss hypothesis and training-dynamics-based sample selection established in the noisy-label learning literature, we propose a novel framework for detecting noisy keypoint annotations. A hybrid convolutional-attention model is trained to predict the anatomical category of each keypoint from its spatial coordinates and local visual features; the resulting cross-entropy training dynamics are then used to derive per-keypoint descriptors, which are partitioned into clean and noisy subsets via unsupervised clustering. We validate the approach on NeoPose, a newly collected dataset of 65 hospitalized preterm infants, under two realistic noise scenarios (random positional perturbation and left-right swapping) across multiple noise levels. Results show that the proposed approach achieves an F1-score of up to 91.9% in noisy-keypoint detection. The framework further generalizes to the heterogeneous COCO benchmark, where filtering CE-detected noisy keypoints from the training set also yields measurable improvements (up to 7.4 AP points) in downstream pose estimation accuracy at moderate-to-high noise levels.
tldr: 基于训练动态和无监督聚类检测婴儿姿态估计中的噪声关键点标注，F1最高91.9%并提升下游AP。
motivation: 早产儿自发运动分析日益依赖无标记姿态估计，但训练准确模型需要大量人工标注关键点，而人工标注易出错。临床场景中错位关键点会作为伪影传播到重建关节轨迹，因此需要可靠检测噪声关键点标注。
method: 基于小损失假设和噪声标签学习中的训练动态样本选择，提出噪声关键点检测框架。方法训练混合卷积-注意力模型，从关键点空间坐标和局部视觉特征预测其解剖类别，再由交叉熵训练动态得到逐关键点描述子，并通过无监督聚类划分为干净与噪声子集。
result: 在包含65名住院早产儿的新数据集NeoPose上，针对随机位置扰动和左右交换两种现实噪声场景及多个噪声水平，噪声关键点检测F1最高达91.9%。在异构COCO基准上，过滤通过该方法检测出的噪声关键点后，下游姿态估计精度在中等至高噪声水平下最高提升7.4 AP。
conclusion: 该工作提出了一种基于训练动态的噪声关键点标注检测框架，可提升婴儿姿态估计数据质量并泛化到COCO等通用基准。其贡献在于减少临床运动生物标志物中的伪影传播，并为噪声关键点标注检测提供可扩展方案。

title: Casual Flash Lighting for Gaussian Splat Inverse Rendering
abstract: Recovering geometry, materials, and lighting from photographs is highly ambiguous when only static illumination is available. Active-lighting setups reduce the ambiguity but require dark rooms or specialized hardware. Instead, we synergize both static and flash lighting from casual indoor capture, with the flash on or off, each from independent viewpoints. The flash residual constrains albedo and the BRDF, while static lighting captures grazing-angle specular highlights that flash misses. With a 2DGS reconstruction framing, our key contribution is a GS-anchored diffuse field: a hash-encoded MLP is queried at the rasterized 2DGS depth. As it depends only on world position, it is view consistent in 3D and allows the flash residual to drive material decomposition instead of being absorbed by alpha-blending drift across views. At the same time, we render static lighting with deferred shading such that it can also supervise material decomposition. On five synthetic and three real indoor scenes, our method outperforms six recent baselines on diffuse color, albedo and roughness material parameters, and in relighting where PSNR improves by 4.17 dB over the next-best baseline.
tldr: 提出结合静态与闪光灯照明的高斯泼溅逆渲染方法，通过GS锚定漫反射场分解材质，重光照PSNR提升4.17dB。
motivation: 仅使用静态光照从照片中恢复几何、材质和光照存在高度歧义；主动光照设置虽能降低歧义，但需要暗室或专用硬件。本文旨在利用随意室内拍摄中同时存在的静态光照与闪光灯（开/关）来缓解这一歧义。
method: 基于2DGS重建框架，提出GS锚定的漫反射场：在光栅化的2DGS深度处查询哈希编码MLP，该场仅依赖世界坐标因而具有3D视角一致性，使闪光残差能驱动材质分解而非被跨视角alpha混合漂移吸收；同时用延迟着色渲染静态光照以监督材质分解。结合静态光照与闪光灯（独立视角）的互补信息：闪光残差约束反照率与BRDF，静态光照捕捉闪光缺失的掠射角高光。
result: 在5个合成和3个真实室内场景上，方法在漫反射颜色、反照率和粗糙度材质参数上优于6个近期基线，重光照PSNR比次优基线提升4.17 dB。
conclusion: 提出了一种结合静态与闪光灯照明的随意室内捕获逆渲染方法，通过GS锚定漫反射场和延迟着色解决了跨视角不一致问题，实现了更优的材质分解与重光照。该方法降低了主动光照逆渲染对专用硬件的依赖，推动了实用化的材质与光照估计。

title: Structural Foundations of Nonlinear Systems with Unknown Inputs: The UID-Induced Normal Form and Minimal-Sensing Structure-from-Motion
abstract: This paper establishes the first general structural solution to the problem of state estimation for nonlinear systems driven by unknown inputs. Building upon nonlinear unknown-input observability theory, we show that every such system admits a structurally equivalent representation, referred to as the UID-induced normal form. The proposed representation decomposes the information carried by the unknown inputs into two complementary components: unknown-input directions that are structurally decoupled from the observable dynamics and observable quantities that completely represent the unknown-input information affecting the observable dynamics. As a consequence, the UID-induced normal form provides a unified structural solution to unknown-input decoupling and unknown-input reconstruction, without requiring any model or stochastic assumption on the unknown inputs. The practical significance of the proposed framework is demonstrated through a previously unexplored minimal Structure-from-Motion configuration. The proposed representation enables recursive state estimation from only three point features and a single-axis gyroscope, allowing the recovery of the three-dimensional structure and camera motion up to an unknown global scale factor. Experiments on real-world data validate the proposed framework and demonstrate the feasibility of this minimal sensing configuration.
tldr: 提出未知输入诱导正规形，统一实现非线性系统未知输入解耦与重构，并用于仅三特征点加单轴陀螺仪的最小SfM。
motivation: 针对未知输入驱动的非线性系统，现有状态估计方法通常依赖未知输入模型或随机假设，缺乏通用的结构化解耦与重构框架。本文旨在建立首个一般性结构解，以在无模型假设下处理未知输入对可观测动态的影响。
method: 基于非线性未知输入可观性理论，证明任意此类系统可化为结构等价的UID诱导正规形，将未知输入信息分解为与可观测动态解耦的未知输入方向和完整表征可观测动态影响的可观测量。该表示无需对未知输入作模型或随机假设，即可统一实现未知输入解耦与重构，并应用于最小SfM配置。
result: 真实数据实验验证了该框架，表明仅需三个点特征和单轴陀螺仪即可进行递归状态估计，恢复三维结构与相机运动至多相差一个未知全局尺度。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 本文首次给出未知输入非线性系统状态估计的一般结构解，贡献在于UID诱导正规形及其对未知输入解耦与重构的统一处理，并展示了最小感知SfM的可行性。该框架为无需未知输入模型的估计问题与最小传感配置提供了理论基础和潜在应用方向。

title: Monocular Navigation Relative to Unknown Spacecraft Using a Transformer-Aided Kalman Filter
abstract: This work presents a novel learning-based pipeline for pose estimation of unknown spacecraft using only monocular images from a single servicer. The approach combines a transformer-based neural network with a Multi-State Constraint Kalman Filter (MSCKF) to estimate the pose (i.e., position and orientation of the target spacecraft relative to the camera) throughout rendezvous and proximity operations. Unlike existing vision-based methods that require prior knowledge of the target shape or inertia properties, rely on additional sensing modalities such as depth, lidar, or stereo, or only recover translation up to scale, the proposed pipeline generalizes to previously unseen spacecraft using a single monocular camera. The transformer network estimates the odometry, the change in pose between images up to scale, from SuperPoint features matched by LightGlue. The MSCKF uses these pseudo-measurements along with an orbit and attitude kinematics model to estimate the pose of the target. In particular, the relative orbit elements, the target's attitude with respect to the servicer's camera, and the associated angular velocity are estimated directly by the filter. Given the monocular approach and short distance to the target, the full observability of the range to the target is recovered via attitude maneuvers by the servicer. The method is trained and evaluated on a re-rendered high-resolution version of the SPE3R dataset, which includes synthetic images of 103 spacecraft. Eleven of these spacecraft are held out during training to evaluate the generalization to unseen targets. Monte Carlo simulations are then used to evaluate the navigation pipeline on rendered trajectories of the held out spacecraft. The results demonstrate that learned vision pipelines as a front-end for Kalman filters provide median errors of 3.7° in attitude and 2.2% of range in ROE when navigating about unknown targets.
tldr: 提出Transformer辅助MSCKF的单目导航方法，无需目标先验形状即可估计未知航天器相对位姿，实验显示姿态误差3.7°、ROE距离误差2.2%。
motivation: 现有基于视觉的航天器位姿估计方法通常需要目标形状或惯性先验，依赖深度、LiDAR或双目等额外传感器，或只能恢复尺度不确定的平移，难以在交会与近距离操作中泛化到未知目标。本研究旨在仅利用单目相机图像，实现未知航天器相对相机的位姿估计。
method: 提出一种Transformer辅助的MSCKF pipeline：Transformer网络从SuperPoint特征（经LightGlue匹配）中估计尺度不确定的帧间里程计，作为伪量测输入MSCKF，结合轨道与姿态运动学模型直接估计相对轨道要素、目标相对相机姿态及角速度；通过服务航天器姿态机动恢复距离可观测性。在重渲染的高分辨率SPE3R数据集（103个航天器，其中11个留出）上训练，并用蒙特卡洛仿真在留出目标轨迹上评估。
result: 在留出航天器的渲染轨迹上进行蒙特卡洛仿真，所提方法对未知目标导航的姿态中值误差为3.7°，相对轨道要素(ROE)距离中值误差为2.2%。
conclusion: 结果表明，学习视觉pipeline作为卡尔曼滤波前端可在未知航天器上实现较高精度导航，验证了仅用单目相机泛化到未见目标的可行性，为空间交会与近距离操作提供新思路。

title: RoboCap: A New Platform for Egocentric Robot Learning
abstract: Despite its promise for scaling robot learning, egocentric manipulation data is still scarce today. Collection at scale requires vertically integrating ergonomic hardware with centimeter-precise 3D algorithms, at a precision that has not been publicly demonstrated. To address this gap, we introduce RoboCap, a 250\,g six-camera dual-IMU hat designed for in-the-wild egocentric data capture, and the Grounded API, a suite of device-agnostic 3D algorithms tuned for RoboCap. In this report, we demonstrate how hardware, calibration, and 3D algorithms interact to achieve state-of-the-art performance on the public benchmarks: our SLAM across diverse settings and rigs, our depth estimation on egocentric settings, and our hand tracking when adapted to third-party devices.
tldr: 提出250g六摄像头双IMU帽子RoboCap与Grounded API，在SLAM、深度估计和手部追踪基准上达SOTA。
motivation: 为规模化机器人学习，第一视角操作数据仍稀缺；大规模采集需要集成符合人体工学的硬件与厘米级3D算法，而此前公开工作尚未证明能达到这一精度。RoboCap旨在填补该硬件与算法协同的空白。
method: 提出250g六摄像头双IMU帽子RoboCap，用于野外第一视角数据采集，并配套设备无关的Grounded API 3D算法套件，针对RoboCap调优。报告展示硬件、标定与3D算法如何交互以实现最优性能。
result: 在公开基准上取得SOTA：跨多种设置与设备的SLAM、第一视角场景深度估计，以及适配第三方设备的手部追踪。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作通过软硬件与标定协同，为第一视角机器人学习提供可规模化数据采集平台，并展示算法跨设备泛化能力，有望推动具身操作数据收集与学习研究。

title: MoonGS: High-quality Representation of the Lunar Surface via Gaussian Splatting Using Robust Depth Features from Image Pairs
abstract: High-quality 3D reconstruction of lunar terrain from sparse rover images is indispensable for autonomous lunar exploration, but remains challenging because viewpoint overlap is insufficient, surface textures are weak, and data volume is limited. We propose MoonGS, the first feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework tailored to lunar scenes. Given only two input images, MoonGS predicts pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass and renders photorealistic novel views without any per-scene optimization. MoonGS (i) adopts an adaptable backbone design that seamlessly integrates advanced vision foundation models to extract robust depth features; (ii) integrates semantic priors in two manners: merging semantic cues with visual features to refine Gaussian parameter estimation, and adopting a semantic ranking loss that regularizes background depth; and (iii) employs an entropy-guided heuristic resampling strategy to augment sparse observations by selecting the most informative distant viewpoints with negligible overhead. Experiments on the LuSNAR benchmark and our synthetic weak-texture MoonBlender dataset show that MoonGS surpasses state-of-the-art feed-forward NeRF/3DGS baselines by +4.9 dB PSNR, +0.29 SSIM, and 40\% lower LPIPS while maintaining sub-second inference. Furthermore, we validate the broad applicability of our framework by demonstrating that it effectively leverages state-of-the-art backbones, including VGGT, to significantly boost performance. Qualitative evaluations on Chang'e mission imagery also show the best visual quality among compared methods, indicating robustness on real lunar data. The source code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/InRobots/MoonBlender.
tldr: 提出首个面向月面场景的前馈3DGS框架MoonGS，仅用两图实现高质量新视角合成。
motivation: 月面稀疏巡视器图像存在视角重叠不足、纹理弱和数据量有限等问题，高质量三维重建对自主月球探测至关重要，但现有方法难以稳定应对。
method: MoonGS在单次前向传播中预测像素对齐高斯基元，无需逐场景优化；采用可适配骨干融合视觉基础模型提取鲁棒深度特征，结合语义线索精炼高斯参数并引入语义排序损失正则化背景深度，还通过熵引导重采样选择信息量大的远视角以增强稀疏观测。
result: 在LuSNAR基准和弱纹理MoonBlender数据集上，MoonGS较SOTA前馈NeRF/3DGS基线提升+4.9 dB PSNR、+0.29 SSIM，LPIPS降低40%，并保持亚秒级推理；在嫦娥任务影像上视觉质量最佳，且验证了VGGT等先进骨干的通用增益。
conclusion: 研究表明MoonGS能有效提升稀疏月面图像的三维重建保真度与真实数据鲁棒性，并已开源代码与数据集以促进后续研究。

title: SteadySplats: Resampling of Low-Variance Gaussians for High-Fidelity Stochastic Rendering
abstract: Stochastic order-independent transparency enables efficient and elegant rendering of primitive-based radiance fields like 3D Gaussian Splatting models, but remains impractical due to the inherent visible noise in the output. We propose a principled approach to minimize high-frequency noise, addressing its sources at the representation and image synthesis level. During stochastic rendering, our history-based spatial resampling scheme drastically accelerates image convergence, while temporal importance resampling ensures coherence under camera movement. During training, a color regularizer implicitly reduces the variance along view rays in the 3DGS models. With these properties, our optimized, Vulkan-based renderer effectively mitigates output noise at low and high sample counts, achieving a substantial 13~dB PSNR increase in quality over previous stochastic methods at 1 sample per pixel and quickly converging to sorted 3DGS with an average L1 error of less than $10^{-4}$.
tldr: 通过空间/时间重采样和颜色正则化减少随机3DGS渲染噪声，1spp下PSNR提升13dB。
motivation: 随机顺序无关透明能高效渲染3D Gaussian Splatting等图元辐射场，但输出中固有的可见噪声使其难以实用。该工作旨在从表示与图像合成层面系统性降低高频噪声。
method: 提出SteadySplats：随机渲染时使用基于历史的空间重采样加速图像收敛，并用时间重要性重采样保证相机运动下的时间一致性；训练时引入颜色正则化，隐式降低3DGS模型沿视线的方差，并实现基于Vulkan的优化渲染器。
result: 在每像素1采样下，相较先前随机方法PSNR提升约13 dB；在低采样和高采样数下均能有效抑制噪声，并快速收敛至排序3DGS，平均L1误差小于1e-4。
conclusion: 该工作表明联合优化表示与图像合成可显著缓解随机顺序无关透明的噪声问题，使随机渲染质量接近排序3DGS，提升3DGS透明渲染的实用性。

title: Deep Prior Learning for Embodied Perception
abstract: Embodied systems need geometric perception that exploits available observations beyond images alone. Recent feed-forward 3D models incorporate geometric priors, including camera poses, intrinsics, and depth. However, handling noisy poses, preserving accurate priors, and recovering physical scale require more than simply accepting these inputs. We introduce \emph{Vision-Prior Geometry Grounded Transformer} (VPGGT), a VGGT-based framework that extends OmniVGGT for prior-aware embodied perception. We formulate sensor-motivated pose corruptions from ground-truth trajectories for training and introduce a parameter-free \emph{prior residual connection} (PRC) to mitigate \emph{prior dilution}, where predictions are less accurate than their supplied pose priors. Our noise formulation targets camera poses; supplied intrinsics and depth receive no additional corruption. We further introduce \emph{Metric Global Attention}, which conditions a global scale token on available pose and depth scales and predicts a shared metric scaling factor for the geometric outputs. Experiments across four datasets show that \emph{PRC} improves translation-direction accuracy and joint pose AUC over a matched training baseline when camera priors are provided for all views, under both exact and corrupted poses. These results support explicit prior access during refinement as a useful addition to feature-level conditioning.
tldr: 提出VPGGT，用PRC缓解先验稀释并用Metric Global Attention恢复统一尺度，提升噪声位姿下的具身几何感知。
motivation: 具身系统需要超越图像本身的几何感知，现有前馈3D模型虽引入相机位姿、内参与深度等先验，但在处理噪声位姿、保持准确先验以及恢复物理尺度方面仍不足。
method: 基于VGGT并扩展OmniVGGT提出VPGGT；利用真值轨迹生成传感器启发的位姿损坏进行训练，引入无参数先验残差连接PRC以缓解先验稀释，并提出Metric Global Attention，以可用位姿与深度尺度条件化全局尺度token，预测几何输出的共享度量缩放因子。
result: 在四个数据集上，当所有视角均提供相机先验时，无论位姿精确还是损坏，PRC相比匹配训练基线均提升平移方向精度与联合位姿AUC；摘要未提供具体数值。
conclusion: 结果表明，在细化阶段显式访问先验可作为特征级条件化的有效补充，凸显显式先验访问在具身几何感知中的价值，并有望增强噪声位姿与尺度恢复场景下的鲁棒性。

title: Have I Scene This Before? Spatially Grounded Conversational Memory for Complex Queries in Egocentric Assistants
abstract: Egocentric assistants must connect what users say with what they see across long interaction histories. We formalize this challenge as Spatially grounded Conversational Reasoning (SpaCR): cross-scene, recall-oriented, and counterfactual spatial queries that combine user-stated facts with geometric evidence. Direct vision-language models incur high inference costs and context limits as histories grow, while keyframe selection and retrieval can omit objects or evidence needed for complete recall. We propose Spatially grounded Conversational Memory (SpaC-MEM), an object-centric working memory that uses 3D reconstruction and segmentation to ground conversational information in persistent physical objects. It compresses multimodal histories while preserving spatial evidence and allowing object-specific facts to be updated through dialogue. We also introduce Ego-SpaCR, a benchmark comprising 620 ScanNet video sessions augmented with 95 task-oriented conversations and 3,100 evaluation queries. SpaC-MEM achieves the highest overall answer accuracy among the evaluated methods and improves object recall while requiring substantially fewer reference input tokens than native-video baselines. Removing 3D spatial information substantially degrades performance, highlighting the importance of preserving spatial and conversational evidence together.
tldr: 提出以物体为中心的SpaC-MEM，用3D重建与分割将对话记忆锚定到物理对象，在Ego-SpaCR基准上提升复杂空间查询准确率并减少输入token。
motivation: 第一人称助手需在长交互历史中连接用户言语与所见内容，但直接使用视觉语言模型推理成本高且受上下文长度限制，关键帧选择与检索又可能遗漏完整回忆所需的物体或证据。为此，论文形式化定义跨场景、面向回忆与反事实的空间查询任务SpaCR。
method: 提出SpaC-MEM，一种以物体为中心的工作记忆，利用3D重建与分割将对话信息锚定到持续存在的物理对象，压缩多模态历史同时保留空间证据，并支持通过对话更新对象级事实。同时构建Ego-SpaCR基准，包含620个ScanNet视频会话、95个任务导向对话和3100条评估查询。
result: SpaC-MEM在所有评估方法中取得最高总体答案准确率，提升物体召回率，且所需参考输入token显著少于原生视频基线。消融实验表明，移除3D空间信息会显著降低性能。
conclusion: 结果表明，联合保留空间与对话证据对第一人称助手的复杂回忆查询至关重要；SpaC-MEM为可扩展的空间锚定对话记忆提供了有效方案，Ego-SpaCR基准可推动后续研究。

title: Mobile-4DGS: Unified Static-Dynamic Real-time Mobile Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have achieved remarkable performance in novel view synthesis, yet deploying both static and dynamic Gaussian representations on resource-constrained mobile devices remains challenging due to heavy storage, redundant primitives, and costly per-frame computation. We present Mobile-4DGS, a unified lightweight framework for high-fidelity real-time static and dynamic Gaussian rendering on mobile platforms. For compact appearance modeling, we introduce a Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator that compresses high-order radiance residuals into the first-order Spherical Harmonics (SH), together with an Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement module whose predicted offsets are pre-baked before inference. We further propose a Multi-View Alpha-Based Densification and Pruning strategy to suppress redundant primitives while maintaining multi-view consistency. For dynamic scenes, we develop a compact explicit 4D representation by constructing second-order Gaussian motion, learnable temporal support, and a binary static-dynamic partition, enabling continuous-time modeling without runtime deformation networks. Based on this partition, a Depth-Order Certificate selectively reuses previously committed depth orders to reduce re-projection, sorting, merging, and index-buffer updates during playback. Extensive experiments on static and dynamic scenes demonstrate that Mobile-4DGS substantially reduces storage and rendering overhead while maintaining competitive visual quality, enabling real-time 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting on mobile devices. \textcolor{magenta}{\href{https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}{Code has been released: https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}}.
tldr: Mobile-4DGS 通过压缩外观、剪枝冗余基元与显式 4D 建模，实现移动端实时静态与动态高斯渲染。
motivation: 3DGS 在新视角合成上表现优异，但静态与动态高斯表示存在存储量大、基元冗余、逐帧计算开销高的问题，难以部署到资源受限的移动设备上；现有动态方法还依赖运行时变形网络，进一步加重端侧负担。
method: 提出统一轻量框架 Mobile-4DGS：用 Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator 将高阶辐射残差压缩进一阶球谐，并用 Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement 在推理前预烘焙偏移；通过 Multi-View Alpha-Based Densification and Pruning 抑制冗余基元并保持多视角一致；动态部分构建二阶高斯运动、可学习时间支撑与二值静动态划分的紧凑显式 4D 表示，避免运行时变形网络，并利用 Depth-Order Certificate 复用已提交的深度顺序，减少重投影、排序、合并与索引缓冲更新。
result: 在静态与动态场景上的大量实验表明，Mobile-4DGS 在保持有竞争力视觉质量的同时显著降低存储与渲染开销，从而在移动设备上实现实时的 3D 与 4D 高斯泼溅渲染；摘要未给出具体量化指标，代码已开源。
conclusion: 该工作将静态与动态高斯渲染统一到单一轻量框架中，通过外观压缩、基元剪枝、显式 4D 表示与深度顺序复用等设计，为移动端实时 3D/4D 内容消费提供了可行方案，并已开源代码以推动后续研究与落地。

title: EMG-GPT: Predictive Pretraining on Residual-Quantized EMG Tokens for Hand Pose Estimation
abstract: Surface electromyography (sEMG) is a low-power, cost-effective biosignal for hand-pose estimation and gesture classification. In this work, we examine whether self-supervised pretraining on sEMG can yield transferable representations for continuous hand-pose estimation. We introduce EMG-GPT, a causal transformer-based model that operates on discrete sEMG representations from a frozen residual vector quantization (RVQ) tokenizer and learns temporal dynamics through depth-autoregressive future-code prediction. The model combines within-frame integration with causal temporal modeling while preserving the geometry of the pretrained codebook. EMG-GPT shows competitive results in both Regression and Tracking tasks, supporting EMG-only pretraining as a viable approach for learning transferable sEMG representations.
tldr: EMG-GPT利用RVQ离散肌电令牌进行因果预测预训练，在回归与追踪任务上取得竞争力结果。
motivation: sEMG是一种低功耗、低成本的生物信号，可用于手部姿态估计与手势分类；本文关注其自监督预训练能否产生可迁移的连续手部姿态估计表示。
method: 提出EMG-GPT，一种基于因果Transformer的模型，在冻结的残差向量量化(RVQ)分词器产生的离散sEMG表示上，通过深度自回归未来码预测学习时间动态。模型结合帧内整合与因果时序建模，并保持预训练码本的几何结构。
result: EMG-GPT在Regression和Tracking任务上均取得有竞争力的结果；摘要未提供具体量化指标或对比基线数值。
conclusion: 结果表明仅用EMG进行预训练可作为学习可迁移sEMG表示的有效途径，为连续手部姿态估计提供了新思路。

title: F$^2$ SLAM: Turning Feed-Forward Geometry into Persistent Factors for SLAM
abstract: Feed-forward 3D models provide strong multi-view geometric priors, while on- line simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) relies mainly on local mea- surements and can accumulate drift over long sequences. Existing attempts to combine the two typically treat feed-forward predictions as an external geomet- ric state that is aligned or fused with the online estimate after the fact, which keeps broader multi-view evidence outside the optimizer that refines the SLAM state. We present F2SLAM, which instead converts feed-forward geometry di- rectly into optimization-native target-weight measurements attached to a persis- tent dense factor graph. A high-frequency stream maintains local tracking con- straints and graph connectivity, while a low-frequency stream uses wider multi- view context to selectively refresh existing measurements after a state-consistency check. Both streams constrain the same poses, inverse depths, and optional cam- era intrinsics through a single dense bundle adjustment. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate consistently strong trajectory estimation and improved dense reconstruction in both calibrated and uncalibrated settings. Notably, the uncalibrated configuration reduces the average ATE RMSE from 0.030 m for the strongest feed-forward baseline to 0.002 m on the Replica dataset.
tldr: F2SLAM将前馈几何直接转为持久密集因子图中的优化原生测量，以低漂移在线SLAM提升轨迹与稠密重建。
motivation: 前馈三维模型能提供强多视图几何先验，但在线SLAM主要依赖局部测量，长序列中易累积漂移。现有结合方法多将前馈预测视为外部几何状态，事后对齐或融合，使更广的多视图证据游离于优化SLAM状态的优化器之外。
method: F2SLAM将前馈几何直接转换为挂在持久密集因子图上的优化原生目标权重测量。高频流维持局部跟踪约束与图连通性，低频流利用更广多视图上下文，在状态一致性检查后选择性刷新已有测量；两路流通过单次稠密光束法平差共同约束位姿、逆深度和可选相机内参。
result: 在多个基准上，F2SLAM在标定与未标定设置下均取得稳定较强的轨迹估计并改善稠密重建。未标定配置下，Replica数据集上平均ATE RMSE由最强前馈基线的0.030 m降至0.002 m。
conclusion: F2SLAM的贡献在于把前馈几何转化为优化器内的持久因子，而非外部对齐状态，从而统一在线SLAM与多视图先验。该方法显著降低漂移并提升稠密重建，尤其利于未标定场景，有望推动学习先验与经典SLAM优化的深度融合。

title: FreeLoc: Online Floorplan Localization via Diffusion-Aided Pose Refinement
abstract: Floorplans provide compact and widely available geometric maps for indoor localization, but existing high-performing floorplan-based methods still convert them into dense scene-specific offline databases, tying accuracy, storage, and runtime to the sampling resolution of the discretized pose space. We present FreeLoc, an online RGB-based floorplan localization framework that treats the floorplan as a directly queryable geometric map. FreeLoc introduces an efficient online geometric querying and diffusion-aided refinement scheme, which retrieves plausible pose anchors through on-the-fly floorplan ray querying and refines them into accurate continuous pose estimates. For sequential localization, FreeLoc develops an online likelihood construction strategy that bridges single-frame localization and probabilistic temporal fusion by constructing likelihoods from coarse-sampled candidates and refined pose hypotheses, enabling histogram-filter-based temporal fusion without offline databases. Experiments demonstrate real-time online inference and state-of-the-art performance in both single-frame and sequential localization, while real-world results validate practical deployability in indoor robotic localization scenarios.
tldr: FreeLoc将平面图作为可在线查询地图，用扩散精化位姿，免离线库实现实时室内定位。
motivation: 现有高性能基于平面图的室内定位方法通常将平面图转换为稠密的场景特定离线数据库，使精度、存储和运行时间受离散位姿空间采样分辨率制约。因此，需要一种无需离线数据库、能在线直接利用平面图进行RGB定位的方法。
method: FreeLoc将平面图视为可直接查询的几何地图，通过在线平面图射线查询检索可行位姿锚点，并利用扩散辅助精化获得连续而准确的位姿估计。对于序列定位，它从粗采样候选和精化位姿假设中在线构建似然，无需离线数据库即可实现直方图滤波时序融合。
result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标；实验表明FreeLoc可实时在线推理，在单帧和序列定位上均达到当前最优性能，并在真实场景中验证了室内机器人定位的可部署性。
conclusion: FreeLoc通过将平面图作为直接可查询几何地图并引入扩散辅助在线精化，消除了对离线数据库的依赖。其贡献在于实现无需离线数据库的实时在线平面图定位，并在真实室内机器人场景中展示可部署性，为可扩展的室内定位提供了新方案。

title: SteadySplats: Resampling of Low-Variance Gaussians for High-Fidelity Stochastic Rendering
abstract: Stochastic order-independent transparency enables efficient and elegant rendering of primitive-based radiance fields like 3D Gaussian Splatting models, but remains impractical due to the inherent visible noise in the output. We propose a principled approach to minimize high-frequency noise, addressing its sources at the representation and image synthesis level. During stochastic rendering, our history-based spatial resampling scheme drastically accelerates image convergence, while temporal importance resampling ensures coherence under camera movement. During training, a color regularizer implicitly reduces the variance along view rays in the 3DGS models. With these properties, our optimized, Vulkan-based renderer effectively mitigates output noise at low and high sample counts, achieving a substantial 13~dB PSNR increase in quality over previous stochastic methods at 1 sample per pixel and quickly converging to sorted 3DGS with an average L1 error of less than $10^{-4}$.
tldr: 提出SteadySplats，通过重采样与颜色正则化降低随机渲染噪声，1spp下PSNR提升13dB。
motivation: 随机顺序无关透明度能高效渲染3D Gaussian Splatting等基元辐射场，但输出存在明显可见噪声，导致其难以实用。该工作旨在从表示与图像合成层面抑制高频噪声源。
method: 训练阶段引入颜色正则化，隐式降低3DGS模型沿视射线的方差；随机渲染阶段采用基于历史的空间重采样加速图像收敛，并用时间重要性重采样保证相机运动下的时序一致性，最终实现基于Vulkan的优化渲染器。
result: 在1 sample per pixel下，该方法相比先前随机方法取得约13 dB的PSNR提升，并在低与高采样数下均有效抑制输出噪声；同时快速收敛到排序3DGS结果，平均L1误差小于1e-4。
conclusion: 该方法从表示与合成两端降低随机渲染噪声，使随机顺序无关透明度对3DGS高保真渲染更实用。其贡献包括低方差高斯重采样策略、颜色正则化与Vulkan渲染器，有望推动高效透明渲染和实时辐射场应用。

title: WiSPER: Pose-Supervised Predictive and Residual Flow Refinement For Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With WiFi CSI
abstract: Multi-person 3D pose estimation with WiFi channel state information (CSI) is challenging because reflections from different people overlap without directly identifying individual joints. Existing masked embedding objectives capture wireless relationships without explicit pose supervision, while structured decoders can retain coordinate errors. We propose WiSPER, a two-stage framework combining pose-aware predictive pretraining with conditional residual flow refinement. Pose-Aware Masked Embedding Learning (PAMEL) couples masked latent prediction with auxiliary pose-set supervision on the same CSI context, guiding the encoder toward joint localization from partial observations. Residual Flow refinement with Transformer (ReFT) generates a set of pose candidates to accommodate a variable number of people and refines each candidate through a conditional flow guided by its coarse coordinates and per-joint decoder features. Both stages use paired CSI and pose annotations during training, while inference requires only CSI. Experiments on the PiW3D dataset show that WiSPER achieves an overall mean per-joint position error of 63.72 mm, a 40.0% reduction relative to WiFi-JEPA.
